posts.title: A November to Remember
posts.description: This has been quite the November. November 12-13: Microsoft 365 and their cloud services went down globally for about 24 hours. November 13: Anthropic (Claude) had an API outage that lasted a few hours. This was partially related to the Microsoft outage. November 13: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued a nationwide ground stop that lasted over 4 hours. The backlog took days to resolve

posts.title: C2PA and Consistently Inconsistent Validators
posts.description: When evaluating media provenance, the single most critical requirement is having consistent and repeatable results.
